column1: # Pod-speed calibration candidates (run_arms.py calib-ref --calib): name TAB path (relative to the
# TPTP pool root of ~/.cache/thvm/enigma/matrix/tptp_pool.tgz).  The calibration runs one
# the wm lane's flags are empty, and no clock-gated discipline is on), because --schedule races
# 46 lanes and solves all but a handful of TRAIN problems in under 3 s, where start-up and fixed
# real-time costs dominate.  These are TRAIN problems, stem-disjoint from J13, not -10, not in
# DEV-T, that the wm lane proved in 2.6-29.5 s at 60 s in the lane matrix (2026-10-02).
# calib-ref keeps the 10 longest whose spread over its passes is at most 10%.
